manifest.cold_condition: Models loaded; warm-up 5 per size; ready indexes; no OS/DB/GPU cache flush
manifest.period: 2026-10-25 UTC; exact timestamps recorded in performance.json

list_api.measurement: MemoryClient.list_memories; full typed response; once after runner

preparation.method: Docker UTC access-log response-header boundaries; includes driver and listing preflight; excludes typed body validation; same method as PR #82

projection_diagnostic.scope: Post-run read-only diagnostic; one generated-memory seed in unchanged 1000-item ST DB; r11 method from git source, r12 deployed method; not runner instrumentation; no equivalent revisions/relations injected; timings illustrative only

queries: WITH relations AS (SELECT from_id,to_id,type FROM memory_relations WHERE character_id=%s UNION SELECT from_id,to_id,type FROM memory_candidate_relations WHERE character_id=%s) SELECT to_id AS memory_id FROM relations WHERE from_id=ANY(%s) AND (type<>'derives' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM derived_memories m WHERE m.character_id=%s AND m.id=to_id AND NOT m.search_eligible)) UNION SELECT from_id FROM relations WHERE to_id=ANY(%s) AND (type<>'derives' OR NOT to_id=ANY(%s))
SELECT memory_id FROM memory_generated WHERE character_id=%s AND turn_id IN (SELECT turn_id FROM memory_generated WHERE character_id=%s AND memory_id=ANY(%s))
SELECT turn_id,memory_id,payload FROM memory_generated WHERE character_id=%s AND memory_id=ANY(%s)
Composed([SQL('SELECT memory_id,turn_id FROM '), Identifier('memory_generated_sources'), SQL(' WHERE character_id=%s AND memory_id=ANY(%s) ORDER BY memory_id,position')])
SELECT memory_id FROM memory_candidates WHERE character_id=%s AND turn_id=ANY(%s)

SELECT c.turn_id,c.memory_id,c.payload FROM memory_candidates c JOIN memory_extractions e USING(character_id,turn_id) WHERE c.character_id=%s AND e.status='done' AND (%s::text[] IS NULL OR c.memory_id=ANY(%s))
Composed([SQL('SELECT memory_id,turn_id FROM '), Identifier('memory_candidate_sources'), SQL(' WHERE character_id=%s AND memory_id=ANY(%s) ORDER BY memory_id,position')])

WITH relations AS (SELECT from_id,to_id,type FROM memory_relations WHERE character_id=%s UNION SELECT from_id,to_id,type FROM memory_candidate_relations WHERE character_id=%s) SELECT to_id AS memory_id FROM relations WHERE from_id=ANY(%s) AND (type<>'derives' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM derived_memories m WHERE m.character_id=%s AND m.id=to_id AND NOT m.search_eligible)) UNION SELECT from_id FROM relations WHERE to_id=ANY(%s) AND (type<>'derives' OR NOT to_id=ANY(%s))
